summary: Explore islands, solve smart puzzles, and unlock secrets for curious kids
description:
HOIST YOUR SAILS… ADVENTURE AWAITS!
Climb aboard Pango’s ship, raise the black flag, and set off to sea! From island to island, explore a mysterious archipelago filled with funny pirates, tropical animals, and surprising sea creatures.

On each island, a new puzzle awaits: open a secret passage, activate a mechanism, rebuild an ancient monument, find your way through a maze, or sort and match objects. Every challenge brings you one step closer to a precious treasure.

Your mission: find all 21 legendary treasures and bring them back to Pango’s island. A treasure hunt full of humour, observation, and logical thinking!

A PANGO CREATION
For over 15 years, Pango has been creating smart, accessible, and gentle games, enjoyed by more than 15 million children worldwide.
Pango Pirate continues this mission: an interactive adventure that sparks thinking, logic, and curiosity in a joyful, stress-free world.

WHY PARENTS LOVE PANGO PIRATE
- Develops observation, logic, and understanding of simple mechanisms
- Strengthens spatial orientation and curiosity for exploration
- Varied puzzles: mazes, sequences, shapes, sorting, logic challenges
- A lively, funny, interactive world
- No pressure, no scores, no time limits
- Perfect for children ages 3+
- A progressive adventure with over 30 puzzles to solve

A 100% SAFE GAME FOR CHILDREN
• No in-app purchases  
• No ads  
• No external links  
• Built-in parental controls  
• Compliant with children's data-protection standards  

PANGO VALUES: ADVENTURE, LOGIC, KINDNESS
At Pango, we design experiences shaped for young children: simple, immersive, and enriching. Our games nurture curiosity, reflection, and discovery — without stress or competition.

Need help? Questions? pango@studio-pango.com

More info: www.studio-pango.com

DOWNLOAD PANGO PIRATE and let your child dive into a treasure hunt full of puzzles, discoveries, and exploration: SET SAIL FOR ADVENTURE… TREASURES AWAIT!
